final_text:
User Story:
As a user, I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way so that others can learn about my interests, skills, and background.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The user can input text in predefined sections (e.g., About Me, Skills, Hobbies).
- The page allows for formatting options (e.g., bullet points, headings) to enhance readability.
- Users can preview their page before publishing to ensure the content is displayed as intended.

Test Outline:
- Verify that users can fill out and save information in each section of their profile.
- Check that formatting options are available and function correctly.
- Test the preview feature to ensure it accurately reflects the final published page.

final_text:
User Story:
As a professional, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner so that I can earn that designation and enhance my career opportunities.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The application form is accessible online and can be completed in under 15 minutes.
- Confirmation of application submission is received via email within 5 minutes.
- The application review process is completed within 2 weeks, with feedback provided.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form is available and functional on the website.
- Check the email for confirmation after submitting the application.
- Track the timeline of the application review process to ensure it meets the 2-week criterion.
